c74object.name: evi_clipping
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_clipping.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_clipping.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_clipping.genexpr file also requires:
evi_utilities.genexpr
evi_interp.genexpr
About this File:
Antialiased antiderivative and oversampled clipping functions for treating your precious audio well when clipping is required. A choice of four clippers are available: Hard clipping, Diode clipping, Asymmetric clipping and Soft clipping. The oversampled versions of these functions can give up to +40dB headroom, but using just the antiderivatives when not clipping too hard are also very effective. These are for all people who disastrously like to use [clip~ -1. 1.] in their patchers (you should never do this).

entry.name: diodeCoeffs ( )
entry.description:
Coefficients for Diode clipper function, this only ever needs updating if the samplerate changes
In 1: type=input: SR, Input SAMPLERATE
In 2: type=Param (optional): CR, default: 0.000022, min: 0, max: 0, Constant, do not change
In 3: type=Param (optional): IR, default: 2.2e-13, min: 0, max: 0, Constant, do not change
In 4: type=Param (optional): VT, default: 0.026, min: 0, max: 0, Constant, do not change
Return 1: k1, k1 coefficient
Return 2: k2, k2 coefficient
Return 3: k3, k3 coefficient
Return 4: k4, k4 coefficient
Return 5: k5, k5 coefficient
Return 6: k6, k6 coefficient
Return 7: VT, VT coefficient
Return 8: A1, A1 coefficient
